description: This file defines configuration classes for setting up NATS streaming within Orleans hosting environment, including methods for configuring NATS options, cache size, and partitioning for both silo and cluster client configurations.

classes.name: SiloNatsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for NATS streaming in Orleans silo environment, allowing customization of NATS options, cache, and partitioning.

classes.name: ClusterClientNatsStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configurator for NATS streaming in Orleans cluster client environment, enabling configuration of NATS options and partitioning.

methods.name: ConfigureNats
methods.description: Configures NATS options using a provided configuration action.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures cache size for the stream cache, with a default size.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions/queues for stream distribution.
